versions.content: The parameter mode of the function EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget shall be the identifier of a sleep or reset mode. The mode parameter shall only be used if the target parameter equals ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_SLEEP or ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_RESET . In all other cases, it shall be ignored. Only sleep or reset modes that are defined at configuration time and are stored in the EcuMCommonConfiguration container (see ECUC_EcuM_00181 ) are allowed as parameters.
